detailed_description:
The target video uses a realistic cinematic romantic-comedy style with warm amber café lighting, shallow depth of field, natural facial animation, and soft blue rain light outside. The two characters, their clothing, the café layout, and the two identical matte-black smartphones remain visually consistent.

[Shot 1] A medium-wide shot establishes an elegant café beside a rain-covered street. <Subject 1> sits at a small table on the left, reviewing a paper menu, while <Subject 2> sits at the neighboring table on the right, looking toward the window. One identical matte-black smartphone lies near the inner edge of each table. Their coats and bags remain out of frame. Warm pendant lights reflect across the polished wood while rain forms moving streaks on the large window behind them. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed as a server passes between the tables carrying a tray, temporarily obscuring both phones.

[Shot 2] At 00:03.200, the camera cuts to a waist-level close-up of the adjacent tables. Both characters stand at nearly the same moment after hearing activity near the café entrance. <Subject 1> reaches to the right of his cup and unknowingly picks up the woman’s phone. <Subject 2> reaches left across the narrow gap and unknowingly picks up the man’s phone. Their hands miss each other by a fraction of a second. Neither looks at the screen. They turn in opposite directions and walk toward the same glass door while the camera trucks right with small amplitude to follow them.

[Shot 3] At 00:06.500, the shot cuts outside beneath the café awning. Rain falls heavily beyond the dry entrance area. <Subject 1> stops on the left facing right, while <Subject 2> stops on the right facing left. Both phones ring simultaneously. They look down and see unfamiliar lock-screen portraits. <Subject 1> (S1), speaking in a calm young male voice, says with mild surprise, <d>[Chinese] 等等，这不是我的手机。</d> <Subject 2> (S2), speaking in a clear young female voice, raises the other phone and replies, <d>[Chinese] 我的也拿错了。</d> At 10.00 seconds, they hold the exchanged phones at chest height and look directly at each other beneath the awning, with the man on the left, the woman on the right, the café door behind them, and heavy rain filling the background.

overall_soundscape:
Soft café conversation, porcelain clinks, and subdued indoor room tone transition into heavy rain beneath the awning. Two phones ring simultaneously, followed by the muted city ambience of passing vehicles on wet pavement.
